# BurgTV

> BurgTV is a media player app for your own IPTV playlists (M3U, Xtream Codes), Jellyfin servers and Stalker/MAG portals, on Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV, Android phones and tablets, iPhone and iPad, and also on Macs with Apple silicon and on Apple Vision Pro (as an iPhone/iPad app from the App Store). It is a neutral player: BurgTV does not provide, sell, host or distribute any channels or content. You bring your own legitimate source.

Last updated: 2026-10-28. Current public versions: TV app 1.3.10 (Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV), Android phone/tablet app 1.2.5, iPhone/iPad app 1.0.18 (App Store, on sale since 2026-10-23; the same app runs on Macs with Apple silicon and on Apple Vision Pro).

BurgTV is developed in Switzerland. The app is available in 21 languages; the website in 11 (English, Italian, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Arabic). No ads. Analytics only with the user's consent. Payments via Stripe (TV) and the App Store (iPhone/iPad).

## Key facts

- Sources: M3U playlists (added from a link, http or https; local .m3u files are not imported), Xtream Codes, Jellyfin, Stalker/MAG portals. EPG/XMLTV TV guide: automatic from Xtream Codes or from url-tvg in the playlist; on the TV, additional XMLTV sources (Settings > TV Guide) fill in channels without a guide; time shift -12 to +12 hours per playlist. Portals do not provide a guide.
- TV app (Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV): full TV guide grid, "Tonight on TV", catch-up (when the source offers an archive), timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120; shorter if storage is low), Multi-View (up to 4 channels on one screen, 2 on low-memory devices), recordings, profiles with a Kids profile (age ratings), parental controls with PIN (free: PIN, minimum age, single-channel blocking; daily limit and viewing hours are set per profile, so they need Premium), sports calendar with reminders, trailers and "Check availability" (searches a title in your playlists), Picture-in-Picture. New in 1.3.10: holding up/down scrolls channel number and name and opens the channel on release; blocking a channel is instant; viewing hours and daily limit are easy to confirm with the remote; Back from the movie and series grid always returns to the categories; more reliable Actions bar; protected recordings and more stable timeshift; new option "Open BurgTV on startup" (where supported). Since 1.3.9: live TV recovers by itself if the video engine stops responding, and stops cleanly when the TV is switched off and resumes when it is switched on again; much smoother scrolling (movie and series grids, mini guide, TV guide); safer parental controls (a blocked channel disappears everywhere immediately, Multi-View follows viewing hours and limits). Recordings belong to the profile that creates them; one APK per device architecture.
- Android phones and tablets (app 1.2.5): live TV, movies and series, offline viewing from your own source when the source allows it, timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120, same as the TV app; shorter if storage is low), Picture-in-Picture, subtitle delay, audio tracks.
- iPhone and iPad (app 1.0.18 on the App Store): live TV, movies and series, offline viewing from your own source when the source allows it, timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120, default 30; shorter if storage is low), Picture-in-Picture, AirPlay, subtitle delay, audio tracks. A title appears in "Continue watching" after 5 seconds of real viewing. New in 1.0.18: the app adapts to its window (resizable window or full screen on Mac, iPad next to other apps, foldable iPhones when the screen is opened or closed, Apple Vision Pro); live channels enter History after 5 seconds of actual viewing, even if the app is closed; the parental daily limit counts only time when the video is actually playing; subtitles downloaded during a movie appear right away; Disconnect no longer leaves deleted addresses, titles or searches in the app's files on the device; updating a playlist now really replaces the entries the provider changed or removed.
- Mac and Apple Vision Pro: the iPhone/iPad app is available on Macs with Apple silicon (M1 or later) from the Mac App Store, listed among iPhone and iPad apps, and on Apple Vision Pro as a compatible iPad app. Not available on Intel Macs; there is no Windows app.
- Not on phones and tablets: Multi-View, recordings, profiles and the Kids profile (TV only).
- Premium for TV and Android phones/tablets: license bought on app.burgtv.com, CHF 8.90 per year (7-day free trial) or CHF 25.90 one-time, valid on 5 devices in total across TVs and Android phones/tablets. Free plan, same rules on TV and Android: 1 playlist, live TV, 3-day guide, 10 favorite channels, parental controls with PIN. Premium adds unlimited playlists, Movies and Series, catch-up, timeshift (up to 120 minutes on TV and Android), 14-day guide, reminders, Picture-in-Picture and offline viewing on phones; Multi-View, recordings and profiles are TV only. Full table: https://burgtv.com/en/#premium
- iPhone/iPad: free download with an optional in-app purchase on the App Store (price shown in the app in local currency), separate from the website license, which does not apply on iPhone/iPad.
- Android phones/tablets: every feature is included until November 10, 2026; from that day the same free limits as the TV apply and Premium uses the website license. Anyone using the Android app before November 10, 2026 gets 3 months of Premium as a gift. The Android app is installed from download.burgtv.com (not on Google Play).
- Not supported: new Fire TV devices running Vega OS (they cannot install Android APK files); BurgTV works on Fire TV devices with Fire OS.
